sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: The lists are read from the central unit.

data_description.binary_sensors: On when violated: a door open, motion detected. Set what each one is under "Show as" in its entity settings.
data_description.analog_sensors: Raw values without a unit - the central unit does not say what is wired in.

add_cover.title: Gate or door
add_cover.description: Driven by logic commands: rules in the central unit with an external command condition. Submit an empty form to go back.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.reed_sensor: Optional. Reads closed or not closed - the only thing that confirms the gate moved. Without it the state is unknown.
data_description.open_only_when_closed: Reads the reed switch right before opening and refuses otherwise. Stops a second open command from halting a gate in motion. Leave it off where stopping part-way is wanted.
data_description.travel_time: Optional. The full travel time plus a margin for communication. Adds a Step button that works like the remote - up, stop, down, stop - and makes toggle do the same. Leave empty to disable.

add_valve.title: Valve
add_valve.description: A watering program or anything else started and stopped by a pair of logic commands. Submit an empty form to go back.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.sections: Optional. The outputs this program switches; the valve is open while any of them is on. Without sections the state is unknown.
data_description.main_valve: Optional. An output that stays on for the whole run: in the pauses between sections the program still counts as running.
data_description.auto_close: Optional. Sends the close command after this time. Runs in Home Assistant and is lost on a restart - if watering must end, give the rule its own duration in the central unit.

data_description.open_command: At most 7 characters. A mistyped command is accepted by the central unit and silently does nothing.
data_description.sections: Optional. The outputs this program switches; the valve is open while any of them is on. Without sections the state is unknown.
data_description.main_valve: Optional. An output that stays on for the whole run: in the pauses between sections the program still counts as running.
data_description.auto_close: Optional. Sends the close command after this time. Runs in Home Assistant and is lost on a restart - if watering must end, give the rule its own duration in the central unit.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the central unit.
error.invalid_auth: The central unit rejected the password.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this address.
error.command_empty: The command must not be empty.
error.command_too_long: Logic commands are at most 7 characters.
error.guard_needs_reed_sensor: Needs a reed switch to check.
error.step_needs_unguarded: The Step button needs "Open only when confirmed closed" off: it stops a moving gate with the opposite command.
error.main_valve_is_a_section: The main valve cannot also be one of the sections.

abort.cannot_list: Cannot read the resource list from the central unit.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not running. Fix the connection first.
